name: scala_ui
description: Scala Calendar UI - pure-QML view over the scala calendar core module

provides.description: List the calendars, with how many events each has and whether you can add to it.
List the events in a time range (repeating events are expanded), and show that day in Scala.

params.name: from
params.description: Start of the range: 2026-10-05 for a day, 2026-10-05T15:00 for a time (local time). Default: today.

params.name: to
params.description: End of the range, same format; a bare date includes that whole day. Default: the end of the start day.

params.name: calendar
params.description: Only this calendar (its name). Default: all.

provides.description: Find events whose title, location or notes contain the words.
Add an event to a calendar.

params.name: start
params.description: When it starts: 2026-10-05 for a day, 2026-10-05T15:00 for a time (local time). A bare date makes an all-day event.

params.name: end
params.description: When it ends, same format. Default: one hour after the start.

params.name: calendar
params.description: Which calendar (its name). Default: the last one used, or the only one.

provides.description: Join a calendar someone shared, from their scala://join invite link.
Open the share dialog of a calendar in Scala (invite link and QR code). The link itself stays in Scala.

params.name: calendar
params.description: Which calendar (its name). Default: the last one used, or the only one.

provides.description: Show a day, week or month in Scala.

params.name: view
params.description: day, week or month. Default: as it is.
